author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

`lstWarning` takes a format string and its arguments. It packs the arguments with `std::make_format_args`, and `lstVWarning`, defined in `LST.cc`, formats them with `std::vformat` and logs the result.

`LSTEvent.dev.cc` no longer uses `std::format`, which `nvcc` cannot compile in device code with GCC 16 in c++23 mode with `--expt-relaxed-constexpr`.

See https://developer.nvidia.com/bugs/7145061 and https://github.com/fwyzard/nvidia_bug_7145061 .

#### PR validation:

None.
title: LST: format the warnings in host-only code
